title: English Practice Quiz 0948
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A municipal corporation is primarily responsible for many ___.
questions.explanation: Municipal bodies manage local services such as sanitation and roads, according to law.

questions.question: A birth certificate is an official record of a person's ___.
questions.explanation: A birth certificate records details of birth.

questions.question: A public grievance is a complaint made about ___.
questions.explanation: A grievance raises a concern about a service or decision.

questions.question: The right to vote in an election is commonly called ___.
questions.explanation: Suffrage means the right to vote in political elections.

questions.question: A local ward is generally a division used for ___.
questions.explanation: Wards are local administrative or electoral divisions.

questions.question: A public notice should clearly state the message and ___.
questions.explanation: Dates and required actions help readers understand the notice.

questions.question: A government department's official website is useful for checking ___.
questions.explanation: Official websites can provide authoritative information about public services.

questions.question: A traffic rule is intended to promote ___.
questions.explanation: Traffic rules help reduce risk and organise road use.

questions.question: A public library primarily provides access to ___.
questions.explanation: Libraries provide reading and information resources to the public.

questions.question: A citizen submitting an application should keep ___.
questions.explanation: An acknowledgement number helps track the application.
